points.point: Why posting with Account ID only gives Wrong Page ID
points.sentence: Facebook needs both an Account ID and a Page ID.

points.point: Where to find the Page ID
points.sentence: For Facebook Pages, use Copy page ID beside the Page you want in Accounts.

verdict.reason: This entry explains that Facebook needs both IDs, so an Account ID alone fails. It also says to use Copy page ID beside the Page in Accounts.
